verdict.rationale: Jitsu ships an official, documented `jitsu-cli` that manages workspace configuration objects (destinations, streams, connections) and runs the Functions dev workflow, including `init` scaffolding and `deploy`. The vendor describes it as doing everything the UI does, the GitHub repo corroborates it, and a probe confirms the official CLI docs page exists. missing for 10: independent hands-on or community corroboration of CLI use, especially in agent-driven workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: `jitsu-cli` is the command-line interface for Jitsu. It manages workspace configuration objects (destinations, streams, connections, …) and runs the Functions dev workflow.
jitsu-cli — a real command-line interface that does everything the UI does.
`jitsu-cli init` scaffolds a TypeScript project with tests, and `jitsu-cli deploy` ships it to your workspace.
